source: W20 Changing Breeds (Onyx Path, 2013), each breed's Traits section; Dark Ages: Werewolf for the Garou.
note: Form statistics are not repeated here: the system already carries each breed's form table (totals.js). This table holds what the form table doesn't: the bane, regeneration, Rage, frenzy, Delirium and Renown names. Entries marked chk were read from damaged text; check the page.

Ananasi.note: Blood pool instead of Rage; blood and Gnosis can't both be spent in one turn; not regenerating; no silver allergy.

Bastet.note: Rage and Willpower by tribe, Gnosis by breed (homid 1, metis 3, feline 5). One Rage back every sunset.

Corax.note: Immune to silver; gold harms them in feathered forms.

Gurahl.note: Rage comes back slowly (insults alone don't do it). Rage can buy Strength and Stamina for a turn per point, or extra health levels.

Kitsune.note: Can soak silver at difficulty 8, the rest lethal; no regeneration. Rage by Path, Gnosis by breed.

Mokole.note: Gold and silver both harm them as silver harms Garou. Gnosis needs the sun.

Nagah.note: Frenzy needs six successes and never the Thrall. Rage costs double to raise. One Rage per hour under water.

Nuwisha.note: No Rage and no frenzy. Silver does them no aggravated harm and costs no Gnosis.

Ratkin.note: Crinos Delirium is milder: witnesses count as two Willpower higher. Can't take Allies, Ancestors or Pure Breed.

Rokea.note: Regenerates in breed form only when immersed in salt water; Gnosis comes back only in salt water. Restraint forces a frenzy check.

Grondr.note: Extinct by the modern era. Breeds: homid, metis, scrofa; no auspices.
